title: Answer: no account of what information is, beyond the mathematical sense of reduced uncertainty

statements.text: Predictive processing, in Seth's account, takes no position on what information is. Where the term is used, it carries its mathematical sense, reduction of uncertainty: every conscious experience is one out of vastly many possible experiences, and in that sense informative. Interoception is described as inputs that convey information from inside the body.
statements.scope: the essay The hard problem of consciousness is a distraction from the real one (2016)

sources.locator: the section on informativeness and integration
sources.quote: reduction of uncertainty is what mathematically we mean by 'information'.
interoception, which involves a raft of inputs that convey information from inside the body
